name: Itchy Dragonfly 35
author: Bodyhc
description: Rounded violet button that changes colour on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, text color changes from #560bad to #fff, bottom becomes -30px, left becomes -30px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Itchy Dragonfly 35</title>
<style>
/* Itchy Dragonfly 35 by Bodyhc — https://uiverse.io/Bodyhc/itchy-dragonfly-35 */
button {
  --color: #560bad;
  background-color: #fff;
  font-family: inherit;
  display: inline-block;
  width: 8em;
  height: 2.6em;
  line-height: 2.5em;
  margin: 20px;
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 2px solid var(--color);
  transition: color .5s;
  z-index: 1;
  font-size: 17px;
  border-radius: 6px;
  font-weight: 500;
  cursor: pointer;
  color: var(--color);
}

button:before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  z-index: -1;
  background: var(--color);
  height: 150px;
  width: 200px;
  border-radius: 50px;
  bottom: 100%;
  right: 100%;
  transition: .8s ease;
}

button:hover {
  color: #fff;
}

button:hover:before {
  bottom: -30px;
  left: -30px;
}

button:active:before {
  background: #3a0ca3;
  transition: background 2s;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button class="button">
  CLICK ME
</button>

</body>
</html>
